guards.what: G2 (DORMANT): the sim resolves death INSIDE the damage pipeline, before the dealer's post-damage event; C# defers Kill() until after AfterDamageGiven and AfterDamageReceived have run for every target of the batch
guards.issue: MECHANISM: CreatureCmd.cs:388-409 runs AfterDamageGiven, then the killing-blow-guarded AfterDamageReceived, and only then `await Kill(killedCreatures)` -- so in C# every AfterDamageGiven listener sees the victim at 0 HP but not yet dead, and Gremlin Horn's energy and draw land AFTER them. The sim fires on_death at cmds.py:105, before on_damage_received (cmds.py:122) and before on_damage_dealt (cmds.py:124), inverting both. This is the same architectural difference audit/records/seam/damage_pipeline.json records as its spec step 18 plus guards G6 and N2 -- one verdict per mechanism, binding rule 3 -- and it is DORMANT for the same executed reason G6 gives: no sim power implements on_damage_dealt at all, so nothing runs in the window whose order changed. Concrete trigger: porting any AfterDamageGiven implementer that reads the player's energy or hand (Gremlin Horn's own outputs), or any multi-target attack where a first victim's death would change a second victim's damage. Rule 7: CreatureCmd.cs, sts2_rl/cmds.py and the damage_pipeline record are not hashed by this record.

guards.what: N2: `target.Side != base.Owner.Creature.Side` (GremlinHorn.cs:26) -- a SIDE comparison, mirrored exactly by `creature.side != self.player.side` (gremlin_horn.py:19)

guards.what: N3: the ORDER inside the hook -- energy first, draw second (GremlinHorn.cs:29-30 vs gremlin_horn.py:21-22)
guards.rationale: Load-bearing and matched: a drawn card can be playable only if the energy is already there, and a draw can trigger further hooks (Dark Embrace, Evolve) that read energy. Recorded because swapping the two lines is a free-looking edit that would change what a same-turn auto-play can afford. Both sides also route the draw through the standard draw command (CardPileCmd.Draw / DrawCmd.draw -> player._draw), so reshuffle-on-empty, the hand cap and the per-card draw hooks all fire identically. Rule 7: sts2_rl/cmds.py and sts2_rl/player.py are not hashed by this record.
